missing_values: negative codes, blank or missing; never impute as zero

primary.estimand: latent variance / observed variance for P04 in 2004
primary.interval: model-based Wald 95 percent from observed information

triplets.invalid_solution: report failure; do not clip into admissible range

sensitivity: pairwise polychoric correlations followed by three-wave Heise identity
fit among respondents observed before 2004, a proxy rather than true SHP_I cohort

sampling.cohorts: 1999 original plus 2004 refreshment; no cohort inference from idpers
sampling.mode: telephone in 1999-2009; verify contracted documentation before analysis
sampling.attrition: FIML under MAR; complete-case comparison; MNAR not identified
sampling.design_se: model-based only, not complex-survey-design standard errors

checks: item wording and coding by wave

data_based_interval.specification_envelope: minimum and maximum of nine Heise triplet point estimates, not a confidence interval

curve_use.effect: highlight anchor and interval on frozen a*(r) curve only
curve_use.prohibited: changing grid, targets, strengths, nulls, confirmatory rules, or selecting r after curve results

empirical_illustration: exploratory descriptive aggregates only; no causal claim
privacy: no microdata row or identifier in prompt, log, commit, output, or report
